[[Basaa languages|Basaa]] (A.40)? |iso3=hij |glotto=hiju1238 |glottorefname=Hijuk |guthrie=A.501 }} '''Hijuk''' is a nearly extinct [[Bantu language]] of [[Cameroon]]. [[Guthrie classification of Bantu languages|Guthrie]] had left it unclassified within the [[Bafia languages]] (A.50), but according to ''[[Ethnologue]]'', it has only 31% lexical similarity with Bafia, and 87% with [[Basaa language|Basaa]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Languages of Cameroon}} {{Narrow Bantu languages (Zones A–B)}} [[Category:Bafia languages]] [[Category:Basaa languages]] [[Category:Languages of Cameroon]] {{Bantu-lang-stub}}
